identity.real_world_identity_notes: Customer GT4 racing car on the McLaren MonoCell II carbon chassis with the 3.8 litre twin-turbo V8. It uses the road car's Oerlikon Graziano seven-speed dual clutch Sequential Shift Gearbox, whose electrically actuated wet clutches pre-select the next gear while one is engaged, matching the seven forward gears seen in the drive.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled.
The gearbox is a road-derived seven-speed dual clutch rather than a racing sequential, which is why it has seven gears where most GT4 cars have six.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.mclaren-570s-gt4.20260813t170516846z-de4eb92e by Jason Kinslow.
